body:
تجربة ضغط الليزر ضمن مشروع واعد. أجريت في الجمعية الفلكية الأردنية. وقامت بها الطالبة دانة عربيان ضمن المشاركة في مسابقة إنتل ودعيت إلى وكالة الفضاء ناسا وحصلت على جائزة. وهي الآن تدرس في بريطانيا.

en.title: A laser pressure experiment in a promising project
en.excerpt: A laser pressure experiment carried out at the Jordanian Astronomical Society by student Dana Arabiyat for the Intel science competition; she was invited to NASA, won an award and now studies aerospace engineering in the UK.
en.body:
A laser pressure experiment in a promising project, carried out at the Jordanian Astronomical Society by student Dana Arabiyat as part of her entry to the Intel competition. She was invited to NASA and won an award, and she now studies in the United Kingdom.
